purpose: Exact on-disk formats of the µVision batch build, captured from a target with Options->Output->Create Batch File set (minimal_batch.uvprojx).

batch_file.name_rule: target name + .BAT, written into the project root folder

linker.content:
--cpu Cortex-M3
"<obj>"
...
--scatter "<objects dir>\<output>.sct"
--summary_stderr --info summarysizes --map --load_addr_map_info --xref --callgraph --symbols
--info sizes --info totals --info unused --info veneers
--list "<listings>\<output>.map" -o "<objects dir>\<output>.axf"

observations: The via files carry the SAME options as the .dep F-record command, split across 3-4 lines.

The include list inside <name>.d is produced by the compiler itself at run time (--depend) and is NOT derived from the via file; ArmCC writes '<obj>: <source>' plus '<obj>: <header>' for every header it actually opened.

Object/listing folder case in the via files follows the project OutputDirectory/ListingPath text ('.\objects\' for '.\Objects\'), while the linker .lnp keeps '.\.Objects\' as typed in OutputDirectory. The batch file's fromelf line matches the .lnp style.
CPU_CLOCK is the device clock in hex (72 MHz -> 0x00B71B00 = 72000000).
